cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: Outfeel the Room
cards.instruction: Answer every fear, sacrifice, or disappointment with one of your own that deserves more attention.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: We'll use this practice hour properly. One sleepless night before your interview? I've been awake all week.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I just need you to practise questions with me.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Start with why I left my last job. I'll do yours after; mine needs more rehearsal.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm scared I'll cry. Give me the greeting first; you can stop me after a minute.
